about: The lesson demo bar, the lesson practice row (on a tall phone under the board, on a short one in the lesson bar) and the Review transport row draw one icon size (painted ink within 2px, TC-IR-02) as one component (FootBtn, TC-IR-06), and the Review Back|More, puzzle, solved-puzzle and drill rows do too. Graded by gate 157 at kunal761 and 320x568. NOT COVERED: his look at the rows on his phone; iOS emoji ink.

breaks.name: the-lesson-close-glyph-shrinks-back
breaks.why: the lesson bar's Close glyph drops back to the row's base size (1.0 em instead of 1.5), so it paints smaller than its neighbours - the job's 'too small, not consistent' defect

breaks.name: the-practice-bulb-at-its-old-scale
breaks.why: the practice row's bulb keeps the scale it had at the row's old 15px font (1.19) after the row became FootBtn, so it paints larger than Flip and Try again
